analysis: The PR changes only documentation and a CI self-test. docs/developer/build.md bumps its date and rewrites the description of the darkbloom-sandbox GitHub-side watchdog (now pinned at d6d257c2). The new text covers stranded-job semantics, rescue conditions, and a reminder to set DARKBLOOM_WATCHDOG_MINUTES above concurrency waits. The watchdog token scope is stated as unchanged: actions:write and checks:write only. It is not touched by release or signing runs. scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py updates the pin comment and adds a regression assertion that listings reach jq through a file or stdin rather than as --arg arguments. That is a test-only availability and robustness guard against 'Argument list too long'. It is a guard only, so it weakens no security control. I found no change to provider runtime, attestation, App Attest authorization (TB-011, T-053), encryption, the prefix cache (T-041), or the coordinator wire protocol. The new doc text is consistent with the untouched sections for routing, cache and release isolation, so no threat-model assumption is invalidated. Remaining unverified: the actual watchdog workflow file (.github/workflows/darkbloom-watchdog.yml) and the route and watchdog scripts are not in this batch. Whether they match the documented d6d257c2 behavior and the new assertion is outside the supplied evidence, but the docs and test changes themselves carry no regression.
